desc: The Browning BAR MK 3 Speed Semi-Auto Rifle features a short stroke, gas-piston-operated rifle with a rotary bolt capable of delivering bolt-action accuracy. As part of Browning's Speed-series firearms, this model's operating system also more concealable, lighter weight, and durable for serious use in all the elements. Browning's OVIX camo is featured on the stock and forend. A lightweight, aluminum alloy receiver and the hammer-forged fluted barrel pair beautifully. This BAR also utilized a detachable box-style magazine that attaches to a hinged floor plate, so you can utilize additional magazines.
